premise: Milo and the player slowly build a cosy place to stay from things they find, clean, repair and look after together.
principles: The home grows one meaningful object at a time; each chapter leaves something usable behind.
Use the warm wooden room reference for the small furniture, worn books and gentle light.
The home is one fixed 3D room. Its unearned structure stays completely hidden; the cursor beam only reveals the object required by the active task.
Keep the plant and visiting moth central; living visitors are never possessions.
Make reactions visibly match player actions. Use simple objectives, no inventory dashboard or instructional footer.
Milo develops preferences and contributes ideas. The player is making a place with him.
Shelter protects Milo and his belongings while leaving the plant a place to enjoy the rain.
